required_evidence: application package, version and process identity
actual Class.getClassLoader result for the already loaded target class
defining dex/container path and exact digest if available from the existing diagnostic
classloader parent/delegation context; no constant read that newly initializes classes
method/field values observed in that exact process remain separate from disk constants
